name: history-world-titanic
description: History World: I Accidentally Boarded the Titanic! (Remotion project)

scripts.render: remotion render src/index.ts Titanic out/raw.mp4 && npm run master
scripts.master: remotion ffmpeg -y -i out/raw.mp4 -c:v copy -af loudnorm=I=-14:TP=-1.5:LRA=11 -c:a aac -b:a 192k -movflags +faststart out/i-accidentally-boarded-the-titanic.mp4
